episodes.title: Big Eden
episodes.summary: Top Stasi agent Kleo Straub liquidates a target in a West German nightclub. Soon after, she must face a life-changing betrayal and a heartbreaking loss.

episodes.title: Das Wiedersehen
episodes.summary: Determined to find her files, Kleo tracks down her former handler and makes her way into Stasi headquarters. Later, she seeks out Thilo in a dance club.

episodes.title: Schnee in Sóller
episodes.summary: Kleo heads to Mallorca, chased by Sven. She infiltrates a party and uses a toxin to paralyze Wieczorek's wife, leading him to make a deadly confession.

episodes.title: Der Minister
episodes.summary: With Min and Uwe on her tail, Kleo bribes a little girl to deliver a poisoned Bundt cake to Mielke's jail cell. After a showdown, Kleo digs up a letter.

episodes.title: Uwe
episodes.summary: Kleo and Sven form a wary alliance. Anne visits Kleo claiming to look for her grandfather. After failing to kill her, Uwe sets up a meeting with Kleo.

episodes.title: Objekt Else
episodes.summary: Severely wounded in a shooting, Kleo has a revealing flashback. With the ominous red suitcase seemingly in hand, Sven shares a devastating truth.

episodes.title: Schnepfe und Miesmuschel
episodes.summary: After Andi is wounded by Kleo, a double agent prevents him from unpacking the conspiracy behind the red suitcase. Sven, Kleo and Min move in on a mole.

episodes.title: Die lila Hexe
episodes.summary: Kleo and Sven arrive in Chile, where they track down an elusive Jorge. Later they tangle with Ramona, whose water breaks at an inopportune moment.

episodes.title: Das Seepferd
episodes.summary: A surprise visit from her mother puts Kleo back on the trail of the red suitcase, which could have an unsettling link to her childhood.

episodes.title: Objekt Moni
episodes.summary: Kleo plans a daring heist to retrieve classified files from the KGB, unaware that Sven is after them as well.

episodes.title: Der Bär
episodes.summary: Kleo follows a lead to Belgrade, where Sven makes a romantic connection. Thilo is on a mission of his own.

episodes.title: Molle und Korn
episodes.summary: Thilo discovers that his soulmate is not who she seems. Uwe receives a new target and uses the opportunity to set a deadly trap for Kleo.

episodes.title: Liebesgrüße aus Moskau
episodes.summary: Uwe is left cleaning up a mess. Sven unmasks a double agent, while Kleo heads for her family cabin in search of answers.

episodes.title: Harald
episodes.summary: With the future of Europe hanging in the balance, Kleo prepares herself for a final confrontation in Moscow.
